Little by little, things began to change. Lily keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. A moth circled the lamp all night.

Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Best of all, the tiger is a top predator.
The flower market has become an important part of daily life. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. A solitary knoll breaks the flatland.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Lily often share different ideas about the green hill. For example, the ancient city wall still stands.
On Friday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Eva and Lily are preparing a report about the green hill. Lily ordered noodles and tea at the flower market last night.
